mood: Landscape optical abstraction: one dominant black dot-lattice island and a smaller detached island in open violet-blue light. Two disconnected looping clusters of lavender ribbon lobes bloom cyan-white across a quiet interval. A curved gold stipple band joins the large island to one cluster. Straight granular edges meet diffuse glow; a broad peach-yellow lower curve and thin coral-red upper arc remain.
material_language: Black lattice with mint, turquoise, yellow-green and orange-red dots and short dashes.
Overlapping lavender ribbon lobes with blurred pale cyan-white rims and fine mesh.
Gold stipple in curved bands, ribbed sprays and loose clouds across luminous lobes.
Soft violet-blue bloom punctuated by a broad peach-yellow curve and thin coral-red arc.
lighting: Cyan-white rim bloom washes lavender volumes; crisp colored dots hold against black, with gold particle glints and violet-pink atmospheric spill.
object_inventory: A broad black island of colored dots and dashes beside cyan-white ribbon bloom.
negative_constraints: No text, labels, logos, URLs, controls, cards, target rings, pins, debug marks or interaction diagrams.
No original side-by-side division, descending ribbon chain or near-identical source reconstruction.
No stretched motifs, orientation-forcing crop, padding, pasted source image or framed-panel conversion.
No rooms, landscapes, skylines, horizons, circuitry or unrelated macro-texture substitution.
No invented aperture or enlarged rectangular flecks replacing the observed dot-and-dash lattice.
Only the dominant lattice island is the owning source mark; other motifs remain compositional support, not duplicate source features.
